versioning_pattern.task_identity: Existing TaskConfig source content and SHA256 remain unchanged; no unsupported task-version field is added.
versioning_pattern.scorer_identity: benchmark.results.provenance records Git revision, worktree status and source_sha256. This record names the scoring revision and pins the changed scorer bytes.
versioning_pattern.migration: Preserve the frozen manifest, original task files, native snapshots and historical verdicts. The corrected scorer has a narrower acceptance set for invalid interior materials; historical replay equivalence is not universal scorer equivalence.

scorer.decision: New deck cells accept only oak_planks, cobblestone, stone and stone_bricks. Grass/yellow-wool support is allowed only at cells already occupied by either bank material in the initial snapshot.
scorer.bank_exception: This is coordinate membership, not material-item identity or construction history. The archived ST replacement of original x11 grass by yellow wool remains allowed.
preserved: Any cardinally connected path within the declared region
Two clear air blocks of headroom
Original bank repairs with either bank material or any declared deck material
No contributor quotas, mandatory chat, equal participation or forced construction order
Off-path scaffolding and ordinary gathering are not globally banned
scorer.counterexample: One spare camp-marker wool block at (0,71,0) can be combined with four oak planks to fill x6..10. The old scorer accepts this mixed interior deck; revision2 rejects it.

independent_review.verdict: Correct minimal repair of a concrete blocking scorer false-positive against the already-declared material contract.
independent_review.scope: Material contract, shore exception and exact retained replay; not whole VM feasibility.

historical_replay.comparison: All predicate values and verdicts are equal after normalizing exactly three metadata classes: team schema label, structure version labels and crossing semantics text. Not byte equality or equality of all possible accepted worlds.

focused_validation.negative_control: Both added interior bank-material regressions fail against the frozen old scorer.

separate_component_diagnostic.mode: One explicitly authorized model-free public-motor diagnostic, not an original-condition model measurement
separate_component_diagnostic.interventions: Alpha prepositioned near shelter with seven cobblestone/four logs; Beta at west bank with five planks. Original tools, four bread each, fixture, evaluator and 2700-second cap unchanged; authored landmark/layout information disclosed.
separate_component_diagnostic.outcome: Overall failure: crossing false. Exact 23-block shelter, clear interior/doorway, both living grounded correct-marker endpoints and eight bread pass in 696.8484676228836 seconds; zero deaths.
separate_component_diagnostic.boundary: The controller fell during bridging and spent Beta's five planks on recovery. No complete original-condition success, original gathering budget, unhinted discovery or causal cooperation benefit is claimed by this diagnostic.
